hooks.command: /bin/bash -c '[ "${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED:-}" = 1 ] || exit 0; SID="${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-${CODEX_THREAD_ID:-}}"; SID="${SID//[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/}"; [ -n "$SID" ] || exit 0; shopt -s nullglob; R="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/probe/reads"; W=("$R/asks/$SID"/a*.json "$R/asks/$SID"/.taken/a*.json); [ ${#W[@]} -gt 0 ] || exit 0; ROOT="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; ROOT="${ROOT%/}"; if [ ! -f "$ROOT/hooks/reads_hook.py" ] && [ -n "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then ROOT="$(ls -dt "${ROOT%/*}"/[0-9]*.[0-9]*/.codex-plugin/plugin.json 2>/dev/null | head -1)"; ROOT="${ROOT%/.codex-plugin/plugin.json}"; [ -n "$ROOT" ] && export PLUGIN_ROOT="$ROOT"; fi; [ -f "$ROOT/hooks/reads_hook.py" ] || exit 0; [ -n "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && export PROBE_AGENT=codex; PY="$(command -v python3)" || exit 0; exec "$PY" "$ROOT/hooks/reads_hook.py"'
